import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
one=np.ones_like(t)
def run(names_fn, lo=0.3,hi=0.6):
    def f(w):
        s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
        X=np.column_stack(names_fn(s,c))
        cf=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
        r=y-X@cf
        return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(y)
    res=minimize_scalar(f,bounds=(lo,hi),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-10})
    s=np.sin(res.x*t); c=np.cos(res.x*t)
    X=np.column_stack(names_fn(s,c))
    cf=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return res.x, res.fun, np.round(cf,5)
print(run(lambda s,c:[one,t,s,c,P*s,np.sqrt(P),np.exp(-t)]))
print(run(lambda s,c:[one,t,s,c,P*s,P*c,np.sqrt(P),np.exp(-t)]))
print(run(lambda s,c:[one,t,s,c,P*s,np.sqrt(P)]))
print(run(lambda s,c:[one,t,s,c,P*s,np.sqrt(P),t*s]))

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
one=np.ones_like(t)
def model(th):
    w,p,q=th[0],th[1],th[2]
    s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
    X=np.column_stack([P**p, P**q*s, one, t, c, s])
    cf=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return y-X@cf, cf
best=None
for w0 in [0.42,0.5,0.3]:
    for p0 in [0.5,0.7]:
        r=least_squares(lambda th: model(th)[0], [w0,p0,1.0])
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
res,cf=model(best.x)
print(best.x, np.mean(res**2)/np.var(y), np.round(cf,5))

def M(th):
    w1,w2=th
    X=np.column_stack([np.sqrt(P),P*np.sin(w1*t),P*np.cos(w1*t),one,t,np.sin(w2*t),np.cos(w2*t)])
    cf=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return y-X@cf,cf

    r=least_squares(lambda th: M(th)[0],[0.425,w2])
